summary: Find single pixels on grid edges that are endpoints of lines, trace along the line to find connected closed regions, and fill those regions with the edge pixel's color.
src: single colored pixels s on grid edge that are endpoints of a line
dst: closed regions d connected to the line
match_cond: d is reachable by following the line from s
path: trace along the continuous line from edge pixel s
trajectory: fill interior of each closed region d encountered along path with s.color
multi_step: Step 1: identify single pixels on grid edge; Step 2: trace the line connected to each edge pixel; Step 3: for each closed region touching the line, flood-fill its interior with edge pixel color
